hints.title: Arithmetic Subsequence Definition
hints.text: Any arithmetic sequence of length three or more can be formed by appending an element to a sequence of length two with the same difference.

hints.title: Difference Frequency State Table
hints.text: For each index i, maintain a map of difference d to the count of arithmetic subsequences ending at i with common difference d.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Transitions
hints.text: For pairs (j, i) with j < i and diff = nums[i] - nums[j], previous sequences of length >= 2 ending at j can be extended, each contributing 1 to valid answer count. Update dp[i][diff] by adding previous count plus 1 for the new pair.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        dp = [defaultdict(int) for _ in range(n)]
        total = 0

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i):
                diff = nums[i] - nums[j]
                cnt = dp[j][diff]
                total += cnt
                dp[i][diff] += cnt + 1

        return total
```

complexity.notes: Nested pair iteration with hash map lookup per difference.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsequences and checking arithmetic progression is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing counts per common difference achieves quadratic runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use dynamic programming with hash tables to aggregate subsequences by difference.

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        dp = [defaultdict(int) for _ in range(n)]
        total = 0

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i):
                diff = nums[i] - nums[j]
                cnt = dp[j][diff]
                total += cnt
                dp[i][diff] += cnt + 1

        return total
